title: Former Blade Director Bassam Tariq Criticizes Marvel's Script Process
excerpt:
Tariq says casting began before the Blade screenplay was ready.
He contrasted the project with the creative boldness of Sinners.
body_md:
Bassam Tariq, previously attached to direct Marvel's Blade reboot starring Mahershala Ali, has again discussed his difficult experience developing the film. In a recent interview, he said casting activity began while the screenplay still lacked a sufficiently developed form.

Tariq contrasted the project with Sinners, which he described as creatively bolder than what he believed Marvel was attempting during his involvement. These remarks represent the director's account and assessment, not an official statement from Marvel Studios.

Blade has faced several creative changes and delays. The available report does not establish a new confirmed production or release date. Tariq also emphasized his preference for working on films he genuinely believes are worth making.
